issues.quote: Operating income dropped to $8.9 billion from $13.7 million
issues.problem: Unit error: FY2022 operating income was about $13.7 billion ($13.656B), not $13.7 million.

data.summary: The figures match Tesla's reported FY2023 results except for one unit error: FY2022 operating income is given as $13.7 million when it was about $13.7 billion. The rounding note is correct, since unrounded figures give exactly 19.4% net income growth and an 18.2% gross margin. The rise in net income was driven mainly by a one-time tax benefit of about $5.9B from releasing a valuation allowance.
